message:
Add openai-compatible provider for arbitrary OpenAI-compatible endpoints (#147)

Adds a new `openai-compatible` model option that allows using any
OpenAI-compatible API endpoint (e.g., vLLM, LiteLLM, Ollama) by
setting OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL and OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY
environment variables. The actual model name is specified via --model-id.

This enables benchmarking models served behind custom endpoints without
requiring code changes to agentdojo.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
